description: Andhra Pradesh to launch an AI dashboard for real-time governance, integrating key performance indicators for streamlined departmental oversight.
body_lead: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N. Chandrababu Naidu reviewed the State’s plan for AI-driven and fully digital governance on the second day of the Collectors’ Conference in Amaravati on Friday, as IT and HRD Minister Nara Lokesh announced plans for a unified governance dashboard integrating key performance indicators (KPIs) of all departments onto a single platform, replacing multiple standalone websites and dashboards. The new system is expected to go live within 90 days. Mr.
